access.notes: Standard diamond structure; lattice constant 5.39 Å is the LDA equilibrium value used in the paper. Can be generated programmatically from any crystallographic tool.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, CP2K, ABINIT)

access.notes: Any open-source plane-wave DFT code capable of LDA calculations with Vanderbilt ultrasoft pseudopotentials is acceptable. The paper used VASP, but an open-source alternative must be used.

Available from standard pseudopotential libraries such as SSSP (e.g., Si.pbe-n-kjpaw_psl.0.1.UPF) or PseudoDojo. The agent must select a LDA ultrasoft pseudopotential compatible with the chosen DFT code.
